title: Only MCD2 is running, with a narrow M5 channel
why: The state of the rollout when MCD1 and MCD3 are not at shadow or live yet: synthesis is handed MCD2 alone. The Day Trader's primary sensor is absent, so it stands aside (INVALID, UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE:MCD1); the Scalper gets a LONG (rule 3s). The M5 channel is only 14 wide, so the stops from the structure levels would be under $13: the baseline zone's invalidation is raised to the minimum (MINIMUM_STOP) and the lower zone has no structure level behind it at all (NO_LEVEL), so it is exactly $13 away.
